verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Plans and forecasts section: 'To meet today’s demand and prepare infrastructure for the future technologies at the beginning of 2026 the Company commenced construction of a new Tier III standard data center near Vilnius... The Company plans to invest up to EUR 26 million into the first two data center modules... to be completed by the second half of 2027'

verified_key_information_units.information: Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise (B2B) effective 1 July 2026, succeeding Aurimas Žlibinas.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'A further change in the Company’s management took effect on 1 July 2026. Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise, succeeding Aurimas Žlibinas'; Governing structure section confirms the change.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (revenue growth), K2 (EBITDA), K3 (capital investments), K4 (free cash flow), K5 (frequency block acquisitions), and K8 (dividend distribution). However, it omits the core material meaning of K6 (planned network expansion investment), K7 (mobile data traffic growth), K9 (new data center construction), and K10 (management appointment). These omissions are important HIGH and MEDIUM priority items that change the overall understanding of the company's strategic activities and leadership changes. While most HIGH priority financial metrics are covered, the absence of strategic investment plans and traffic growth context means the summary does not capture all material information, resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. Revenue growth is consistently described across categories (S1-S2). Profit metrics (EBIT, EBITDA, profit before tax, net profit, EPS) all show positive growth trends that align with the stated revenue increase (S3-S7). Operating expenses and cost of goods are explained with plausible drivers (S8-S10). Cash flow and investment figures present a clear narrative of strong operational cash generation offset by higher capex (S11-S13). The dividend distribution (S15) and balance sheet items (S16) are presented as standalone facts without conflicting with other statements. No material logical gaps, contradictions, or organizational issues are present. The summary forms a coherent whole with each section naturally building on the previous one.
